item.title: vSphere 6 Lab Upgrade – vCenter Server Appliance
item.description: I tested vSphere 6 quite intensively when it was in beta, but I didn’t ever upgrade my lab - basically because I need a stable environment to work on and I wasn’t sure that I could maintain that with the beta.

item.title: Slow or failed logon to VCSA 5.5 with vCOps in the environment
item.description: Recently I encountered this problem in a customer site whereby the logon to VCSA 5.5 would either time out, or take 3-5 minutes to actually log on.

item.title: VCSA 5.5 Web Client fails to log on with “SSL certificate verification failed”
item.description: This had me scratching my head, what seemed to be a common problem wasn’t fixed by the common solution. It was actually my fault – too familiar with the product and setting things up too quickly to test.
